stem.en: A car starts from rest and speeds up evenly to 20 m/s in 5 s. It then moves at 20 m/s for 10 s. Then it brakes evenly and stops in 6 s. What is the total distance travelled, in m?

explanation.en: Speeding up: 1/2 x 5 s x 20 m/s = 50 m. Steady: 20 m/s x 10 s = 200 m. Braking: 1/2 x 6 s x 20 m/s = 60 m. Total: 50 + 200 + 60 = 310 m.

hints.en: Sketch the velocity-time graph and add the three areas.
